en.title: Time Until Stable When Failed Services Delete Their Left Neighbors
en.description:
Each second, based on the string at the start of that second, every failedService simultaneously deletes the character immediately to its left; the deleted character may itself be a failed service. Find the number of seconds that pass before the string stops changing.

This site independently wrote the standard I/O and judging; ranges marked as this site's are not original source constraints.
en.input: The first line is pipeline, and the second line is a single failedService character. Length 1..200000; this site uses lowercase letters.
en.explanation: Example 1: the three a are at indices 1, 3, 5; the leading segment has length 1 and the two gaps have length 2, so the answer is 2. Example 2: in the first second, the first three a are deleted simultaneously by their right neighbors, leaving only one, so the answer is 1. Example 3: there is no a and no deletion happens, so the answer is 0.
hints: Record the positions of the failed characters: take the maximum of the length before the first failure and the distances between adjacent failure positions; the suffix after the last failure is never deleted.
